subject: Request: 30-min Hosted API eval — timezone check & pre-run question
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@chainly.io>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Eval request: 30-min hosted API run & timezone check

Hi Evelyn / Diego,

I signed up for the Redwood hosted API trial and I'd love to run a quick 30-minute evaluation with someone from your team to validate generation latency and prompt-handling for our product. We're on Pacific time (PST) and this week our best slots are Tue/Thu afternoons.

Quick background: Chainly is building a smart-contract summarization tool. We have a small test corpus and a couple of prompt templates; main questions are around max context length and whether we can get a short-lived sandbox key for token cost estimates.

Can we book a 30-min window this week? If possible please include an engineer who can answer model/token questions.

Attachments: chainly-tc.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Data, Chainly
samira@chainly.io
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@chainly.io>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-22T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval request: 30-min hosted API run & timezone check

Hi Samira — thanks for signing up and for the context. Happy to set this up.

I can do:
- Tue Mar 23 3:00pm–3:30pm PST
- Thu Mar 25 4:00pm–4:30pm PST

Or you can pick a time from my calendar: https://cal.com/diego/redwood-30

I'll loop in our PLG engineer for the session. Any specific model family you'd like us to test (llama2-style, gpt-ish, or open-weights)?

Best,
Diego
Sales Development Rep
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@chainly.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-22T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval request: 30-min hosted API run & timezone check

Diego — thanks, Thu Mar 25 4pm PST works for us. Please add Ben (cc'd) — he'll join from product/engineer side.

Model preference: we'd like to try a quantized open-family you recommend for low-latency inference. Also one quick question: what's Redwood's recommended sequence length for batching to preserve latency SLA? A sentence or two is fine.

See you then.

— Samira
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@chainly.io>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval request: 30-min hosted API run & timezone check

Hi Samira — great, Thu Mar 25 at 4:00pm PST is locked.

On Tue, Mar 22, 2027 at 10:04 AM Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I can do:
> - Tue Mar 23 3:00pm–3:30pm PST
> - Thu Mar 25 4:00pm–4:30pm PST
>

Prep for the session (15-min live + 15-min Q&A):
- We'll provision a short-lived sandbox API key and a shared notebook for you to run 10-15 prompts. Link: https://redwood.ai/sandbox/abc123
- We'll test a compact quantized model (we'll default to an manticore-2-small variant for latency) and an accuracy run on your sample prompts.
- Recommended max request length for the session: 2048 tokens for stable batching; we'll show trade-offs if you want longer.

Attachments: screenshot-sandbox-config.png

If you want us to pre-run the 3 prompts you mentioned, drop them into this Doc: https://docs.google.com/example (or paste them in reply). Otherwise we'll use the attachments.

See you Thursday — I'll send a calendar invite shortly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
PLG Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
